text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright...!
Yes, yes, YESSS!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I pulled it off...! Following the Tenno Sho (Spring), now at this Takarazuka Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Surely, everyone else too—

text_block_list.name: Downtown Man
text_block_list.text:
"How do you like that! Did you see that, Central?!
That's our Inari One for ya!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you're the best!!
That's our boss!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Inari One is incredible...!
Running like this right after the Tenno Sho (Spring),
she really must be the real deal...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Could she be evenly matched with Oguri...?
Whoaaa! Now I really can't wait for them to face off!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Still, if she can run this well, it makes me wish even more that she'd made the JRA her main stage for the Classic year~. I really wanted to see it~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! I really wish she could've run against Tamamo Cross and the others in last year's Arima Kinen.
Inari One definitely could've held her own!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—She's finally arrived, Inari One.
Running like this right after the Tenno Sho (Spring).
There's no room left for doubt. She's the real deal...!

text_block_list.name: Flat Cap-wearing Reporter
text_block_list.text:
We need to draw more attention to her...!
I'll draft an article right away. The headline will be—
'The Phenomenal Umamusume Bearing Regional Hopes Appears!'

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Nah, not yet.
It's too early to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I... haven't run against Oguri and the others.
The real brawl starts from there, dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare drop your guard, Inari One...!
You ain't become 'Horse Girl of the Year' just yet, y'hear me...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Inari One had run the Takarazuka Kinen to the very end,
even some time after the race was over,
she still carried a heavy, tense aura around her...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —It's still not enough.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
More... more, more!
I need bigger achievements!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So tell me, Boss.
Where should I run next?
choice_data_list: Before that, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
So tell me, Sis.
Where should I run next?
choice_data_list: Before that, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's wrong? Why so formal all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inari One has definitely seemed a bit off lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The old her would have acted much more cheerful
both before and after races.
Just like a lively festival.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And yet, the way she is now—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...No, my bad.
Maybe you're right, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...No, my bad.
Maybe you're right, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone who ran today was strong.
And on top of them, there's still Oguri and the others in this generation.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Unless I deliver undeniable results that anyone can see, I won't reach the 'top'—
I can't become Horse of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
When I think about that, I can't just be satisfied
with today's results and stand still...—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—But hey, I'm good now.
Thanks to what you said, Boss,
I managed to cool my head a bit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—But hey, I'm good now.
Thanks to what you said, Sis,
I managed to cool my head a bit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Panicking right now ain't gonna help! We gotta take today's results as fuel and stride proudly toward the next race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Inari One laughed and said that,
it felt like a bit of her old spirit had returned.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!
Let's deliver results in spring and autumn back-to-back
and shock the whole world!
choice_data_list: This is going to be our toughest battle yet.
This will be our toughest battle yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because Oguri Cap and Super Creek, having finished
their break, are almost certain to enter
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I know. But if I don't beat Oguri and the others, I can never prove I'm at the top. In fact, that's just what I want.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
By the way, are you planning
to go straight to the Tenno Sho (Autumn) from here?
choice_data_list: No, let's enter the Mainichi Okan as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'd like to get our final adjustments done beforehand at the Mainichi Okan, the prep race for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And besides, in the Mainichi Okan, we might get to face Oguri Cap and the others beforehand, allowing us to gauge their strength before the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Understood! Just you wait, Oguri, Creek! The one who's gonna take you down is none other than Inari-sama!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tense atmosphere from earlier has completely dissipated, bringing inward relief.
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Had Inari One truly returned to normal?
I had no way of proving it one way or the other—
